name: xWin referral reward paid on subscription notional that is redeemed in the same transaction
summary: xWinDefi.Subscribe credits the referrer an XWIN reward proportional to the BNB subscribed, with no lock or net-deposit check, and Redeem returns the principal at once. With flash-loaned BNB the attacker subscribed and redeemed in a loop through its own referral contract, then withdrew the accrued referral rewards and dumped the XWIN.
notes: Subscribe requires isxwinFund for the fund; the attacked xWinFarm fund was listed by addxwinFund after both contracts were deployed, so that listing is the reset. The owner's later doubling of the referral rate only changed the size of each reward.

The 607,998.62 XWIN taken in the two transactions was dumped into the XWIN/BNB pair inside the same transactions and crashed it, so it is valued at the BNB those sales realised (903.92 + 104.52 BNB). The flash-loan fees and fund slippage the attacker paid are not netted.
WithdrawReward events over the contract's life show no other claim of this size except the owner's own withdrawal.
